title: Conform Mapping Record
description: One evidence-backed mapping between a source-document concept and a core-document expression of that concept.

mapping_id.description: Stable identifier for this mapping record, deterministic for the same source hash, core hash, source span, and mapping_type.

destination_terms.description: Zero destination terms is valid only for mapping_type no_mapping. One destination term is the common case. More than one destination term is required for one_to_many; more than one source concept collapsing into the same destination term is recorded as separate mapping records sharing many_to_one mapping_type.

evidence.description: Bounded excerpts from the source and/or core document ledgers that support the mapping decision. needs_review and insufficient_evidence may carry zero or partial evidence; every other mapping_type requires at least one item.

escalation.description: reason is empty only when required is false.

adjudication_id.description: Supervisor-assigned identifier linking this mapping to the worker response it was materialized from, or null for a supervisor-only determination (for example a deterministic no_mapping when the source concept has no candidate at all).

reviewer_note.description: Short human-readable note explaining the mapping, written by the worker or supervisor. Never raw chain-of-thought.
